title: Introduce hierarchical adversarial replay and soft-fallback gate
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: We observed intermittent prompt-set regressions during canary rollouts that only reproduce when multiple adversarial perturbations are applied in sequence across a cohort. This PR adds a hierarchical adversarial replay mechanism and a configurable soft-fallback gate so that CI can (1) deterministically replay complex multi-shot adversarial scenarios, (2) produce a compact severity score per prompt cohort, and (3) soft-block merges when severity exceeds a tunable SLO while allowing staged rollouts with attenuation.

Summary of changes: Adds a new replay orchestrator that shards adversarial sequences by hierarchical difficulty levels, a perturbation ladder sampler that composes token- and semantic-level perturbations, and a soft-fallback gate that integrates with the existing CI eval reporter to translate replay severity into pass/warn/fail decisions. Includes end-to-end integration tests and a short doc page describing gate configuration and recommended SLOs.

Design notes: The hierarchical replay is deliberately deterministic by default (seeded RNG) and supports a stochastic mode for stress suites. The replay orchestrator shards sequences into 'tiers' (sanity, targeted-perturbations, progressive-composition) and runs lightweight smoke checks before escalating to heavier scenarios, which reduces CI cost for most PRs. The soft-fallback gate emits a compact severity vector (three numeric buckets) and maps to the CI result via a threshold table; threshold tables are stored in the eval config and can be overriden per-route.

Checklist: • Add hierarchical replay orchestrator and unit tests • Add perturbation ladder sampler and docs • Implement soft-fallback gate + CI reporter mapping • Update smoke/integration e2e test to include a deterministic adversarial replay run • Add migration note for teams using custom gates

Testing and results: Local unit and integration runs included seeded replays for three prompt cohorts (billing, chat-smalltalk, moderation-snippets). On a synthetic regression seed we reproduced a previously intermittent failure with severity=0.87 (fail threshold 0.75). CI pipeline ran eval suite; all checks passed after two quick fixups to race conditions in the orchestrator. Performance impact: mean additional CI time for a full-run ~+28 seconds (tiered mode) and ~+2.1 minutes (full stochastic stress).

Migration and rollouts: Gate defaults to 'warn' for existing configs. To enable strict blocking, add a per-route threshold in eval_config.yaml. Recommended canary: enable hierarchical replay at 'tiered' mode for 2 weeks, monitor severity trends via the eval console dashboard (dashboard link: internal/eval/replay-severity).

Related: references ENG-3291 (adversarial canary investigation) and ENG-3304 (cohort SLO feature).

release_notes: Introduces hierarchical adversarial replay, a perturbation ladder sampler, and a configurable soft-fallback gate to improve regression detection for multi-step adversarial prompt sequences. Disabled-by-default strict blocking; recommended staged rollout.
